# Field guide: sensor installs
Mount each sensor at least two metres from a motor. See the specs.
## Checklist
1. Check the bracket
2. Run the self-test
  1. Green light means pass
| Model | Range |
| --- | --- |
| S-100 | 5 m |
| Contact support for longer ranges |  |
> Measure twice, drill once.
```
install --site north --count 4
```
[image: Installed sensor]
A sensor on the north line.
Docs live at https://example.com/docs.
